results.rationale: No supporting or refuting evidence is attached to this hypothesis, so there is no concrete evidentiary contradiction to reject it on. Plausibility of a solar-proton-event trigger is not itself grounds for rejection.

The single item listed as 'refuting evidence' (haile-2009-c0) actually describes gradual, non-catastrophic megafaunal decline in interior Alaska persisting past 12.9 ka — content that argues against a synchronous impact-driven extinction pulse, i.e. it is consistent with (not contradictory to) the hypothesis's claim that the cosmic-impact cause was 'refuted'. It does not show the actor 'cosmic-impact' is unattested in the -10950 bin nor that the place is outside its tradition, so there is no concrete contradiction warranting rejection.
